fusions.name: Root It Out
fusions.desc: Drives the spade in under the rot and levers it out for 18 damage, drawing out every affliction you have on the target and dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Bed
fusions.desc: Tips the drawn poison into the soil and turns it over around you, dealing 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Clay Poultice
fusions.desc: Packs your wounds with dug clay, removing up to 3 poison conditions from you and restoring 12 health.

fusions.name: Fuller's Clay
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% poison resistance.
